book.name: Eksadas
book.title: Eksadas Wen Detlot Isreil Pipul Bin Libum Ijip

content: God bin gibit detlot tenbala lowa sekantaim

Brom deya YAWEI det trubala God bin tok langa Mosis, “Yu garra gowei brom dis pleis na, en yu garra deigim detlot Isreil pipul weya yubin bringimap olabat brom Ijip, en yumob garra go langa det kantri weya aibin pramis blanga gibit langa Eibrahem, Aisik, Jeikob en ola biginini blanga olabat.
Ai garra jandim main einjul blanga go lida langa yumob, en ai garra andimwei detlot traib gulum Keinanait, Emarait, Hitait, Perasait, Hibait en Jebusait.
Det kantri weya yumob garra go im brabli gudwan garram olkain daga. Bat ai kaan go garram yumob, dumaji yumob brabli adwan pipul, en ai mait gitwail langa yumob langa roud en binijimap yumob.”

“Ol detlot Isreil pipul olabat adbala pipul. Wal yu dalim olabat wanim aibin tok, en yu dalim olabat blanga deigimat ola nekleis en ring weya dei werrimbat, en ai garra jinggabat wanim ai garra dum langa olabat dumaji if ai go garram olabat, ai mait gitwail langa olabat en binijimap olabat brabliwei.” Lagijat na God bin tok. Wal wen ola Isreil pipul bin irrim det wed, deibin stat kraikrai, en deibin deigimat ola nekleis en ola ring deya langa det hil gulum Sainai, en nobodi bin oldei werrimbat detkain ting na.
Det Tent weya YAWEI en Mosis bin oldei tok gija

Wal Mosis bin oldei ringimap det Seikridwan Tent lilbit longwei brom olabat kemp. Deibin gulum det Tent seikridwan, dumaji YAWEI bin oldei jidanbat deya, en wen enibodi bin oldei wandi tok langa God, deibin oldei go langa det Seikridwan Tent,
en wen Mosis bin oldei go deya langa det Seikridwan Tent, ola pipul bin oldei jandap atsaid langa olabat ron tent, en deibin oldei lukinat Mosis gowin langa det Tent,
en afta wen Mosis bin deya insaid langa det Tent, det speshalwan klaud bin oldei kamdan en jidan langa det dowawei blanga det Tent,
en streidawei wen detlot pipul bin oldei luk det klaud langa det dowawei blanga det Seikridwan Tent, deibin oldei baudan en weship God.

Wal YAWEI bin oldei tok brom det klaud langa Mosis jis laik dubala men tok gija, en afta Mosis bin oldei gobek langa kemp. Bat det yangmen hubin oldei album Mosis bin oldei jidan deya langa det Seikridwan Tent wen Mosis nomo bin deya. Det men bin neim Joshuwa, en im dedi bin neim Nan.
YAWEI bin meigim pramis

Brom deya Mosis bin tok langa YAWEI na, “Yubin dalim mi blanga deigim dislot pipul langa det kantri. Bat yu nomo bin dalim mi hu yu garra jandim blanga album mi. Yubin dalim mi yu sabi mi brabli, en yu gudbinji langa mi.

Wal yubin pikimat dislot pipul iya blanga meigim olabat yu ronwan pipul, en if trubala yu laigim mi, en yu gudbinji langa mi, wal yu dalim mi det plen blanga yu, en ai garra kipgon meigimbat yu gudbinji.”
Wal YAWEI bin tok, “Mi na garra go garram yu, en mi na garra meigim yu jidan gudwei langa det kantri.”

Wal Mosis bin tok, “If yu kaan go garram melabat, wal yu nomo meigim melabat gowei brom dis pleis, dumaji if yu nomo go garram melabat, wal ebribodi garra tok yu nomo gudbinji langa mi en langa ola pipul blanga yu, en if yu nomo jidan garram melabat, wal melabat garra jidan seim laik ola najalot pipul.”
Wal YAWEI bin tok, “Ai garra duwit langa yu, dumaji ai sabi yu brabli, en yu meigim mi gudbinji.”
Wal Mosis bin askim YAWEI na, “Yu shoum miselp langa mi weya ai gin luk det brabli shainiwan lait blanga yu.”
Wal YAWEI bin tok, “Ai garra meigim det purdiwan lait main gopas langa yu, en ai garra gulum main ronwan neim blanga yu. Mi na YAWEI, en mi oldei kain en sori langa enibodi weya mi pikimat.
Bat ai kaan larram yu luk main feis, dumaji if enibodi luk, wal im garra dai.
Bat yu gin jandap iya gulijap langa mi langa dijan ston,
en wen det brabli shainiwan lait main garra gopas langa yu, ai garra pudum yu langa opinwan ston, en ai garra gaburrumap yu garram main bingga raidap ai garra gopas,
en afta ai garra deigimat main bingga, en yu garra luk main bekboun. Bat yu kaan luk main feis.”
